user.title: Connect to a Lutron Vive hub
user.description: In the Vive hub's web interface, add an API integration that uses **Login with a username / password**, then enter that username and password here. The hub needs firmware 1.12 or newer (HJS-2 / HMS-2 / HKS-2, or an older hub with the HJS-UPDATE license).

data_description.port: Leave at 8081 unless you know it is different.

reauth_confirm.title: Vive hub login failed
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {host} rejected the stored username / password. Enter the current API integration credentials.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Lutron Vive hub found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found Vive hub **{name}** at {host}. In the hub's web interface, add an API integration that uses **Login with a username / password**, then enter that username and password here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub's API on that address and port. Check the IP address, that the hub is on wired Ethernet, and that the API integration exists on the hub. Details: {detail}
error.invalid_auth: The hub refused the username / password. Hub reply: {detail}
error.fingerprint_changed: The hub's TLS certificate is different from the one saved at setup. If the hub was replaced or reset, remove and re-add the integration.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.
error.login_failed: The hub did not accept the login request. This is likely a bug in this integration, not your credentials. Hub reply: {detail}

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.not_ipv4: The hub was only found on an IPv6 address. Add it by hand using its IPv4 address.

raise.name: Raise
raise.description: Start brightening a Vive light. It keeps going until you call Stop or it reaches full brightness.

lower.name: Lower
lower.description: Start dimming a Vive light. It keeps going until you call Stop or it reaches the low end.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stop a raise or lower that is in progress.
